quote: We propose a new Headline Generation model namely MediaHG to generate topic-catchy and contextual harmonized headlines for vertical niche platforms to enhance the click ratio and draw users' attention.

We propose the MediaHG model which disentangles the eye-catchy features as additional requirements in sequence-to-sequence training. The model is composed of a headline candidates generator and an eye-catchy headline selector.

guideline: The rating score of each model ranges from 1 to 3, with 3 being the best. Additionally, headlines with domain features like female tongue will get better scores in attractiveness.
